name: What are hardware and functional adjustments in construction?

mainEntity.name: What are hardware and functional adjustments in construction?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hardware and functional adjustments refer to the fine-tuning and calibration of various building components after initial installation. This includes adjusting doors and windows for proper alignment and sealing, ensuring cabinets open and close smoothly, calibrating plumbing fixtures for optimal water flow, and fine-tuning electrical outlets and switches for secure connections. These adjustments are crucial for the longevity, performance, and aesthetic appeal of your home.
acceptedAnswer.description: Hardware and functional adjustments involve fine-tuning building components like doors, windows, and cabinets for optimal performance and aesthetics.
